label: One meeting in four time zones: parse, convert and add a duration (fixed moment, no clock)
code:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
text = input('Meeting start (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, Istanbul time): ')
start = datetime.strptime(text, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M').replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo('Europe/Istanbul'))
for name in ('Europe/Istanbul', 'UTC', 'America/Los_Angeles', 'Asia/Tokyo'):
    print(name.ljust(20), start.astimezone(ZoneInfo(name)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'))
end = start + timedelta(hours=1, minutes=30)
print('ends', end.strftime('%H:%M'), 'and lasts', end - start)
print(start.utcoffset(), start.timestamp())
